name: ANA Blue
use: The brand-facing template. White field, deep-blue accent, dense read-not-projected pages. Geometry and palette measured from ana-blue.pptx.

geometry.radius_note: deck-build takes one radius; the template's own panels run 2.0-26.0pt by role. See references/grid.md.

discipline: White field, no shadows, tinted rounded panels carrying grouped content, a 1.5pt accent rule under every title, accent spines coding category, and a full-width tinted band as the page's closing line. Dense and read-not-projected: type is small for its canvas and hierarchy is carried by weight and colour, not size.
never: sky #00A3E6 as text at any size (2.84:1 on white — fill only)
green #2FA84F as body text (3.07:1 — display sizes only)
coloured slide backgrounds; the field is always white
中文 without font.ea set to 微軟正黑體
mixing this identity with Reiser Warm in one file
